card.name: Linking words before low-vision terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas that come right before a word like 'low', 'lowland' or a vision-loss term, in lists of eye problems or habitat descriptions.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word 'low' (and its variants) as the next word.
